previous.changeLog:
Fix native vehicle filtering so selected Classic filters are combined and applied to the carousel data source.
Show all Classic filters directly in the native vanilla carousel filter popover, without a separate ModsSettingsAPI visibility setting.
Synchronize active filter buttons through the Gameface view model so their selected state stays current after each toggle.
Remove obsolete ModsSettingsAPI filter-visibility checkboxes.
Add a complete ZIP with Classic, ModsSettingsAPI, and OpenWG Gameface.

current.changeLog:
Add ModsSettingsAPI checkboxes to show or hide each vehicle-card statistic independently.
Preserve the selected card-stat fields in the user configuration.
Arrange selected card statistics continuously in pairs to avoid empty card rows.
Validate card-stat configuration values defensively before sending them to Gameface.

previous.changeLog:
Fixed: battles you left before the end are no longer missing. The mod now asks the game server for the result of every arena you entered and reports it once the battle is finalised.

Fixed: net credits were too high — auto-resupply of ammunition and consumables was not subtracted. Net credits now match the in-game battle results screen exactly.

Fixed: the same battle could appear twice when a platoon-mate ran an older version of the mod. Reports of the same battle are now merged into one record.

Added: battle start time is now sent with every record, so repeated short battles are never merged together.

Improved: duplicate protection inside the mod — a battle captured by more than one path is reported only once.
